'''Kenton Christiansen''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 9th at [[July 2000 Austin tournament (15 July)]] on 15 July 2000, according to Brian Guthrie's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1008">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-16-austin-tx-7-15-00-director-s-reportd1008/ austin-tx-7-15-00-director-s-report], DeckTech (Brian "Red 81" Guthrie, 16 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-16-austin-tx-7-15-00-director-s-reportd1008/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
